brief:
Al-Quds University's Master of Business Administration program has been ranked among the world's top 300 MBA offerings for the third consecutive year, according to the Ma'an news agency. The program maintains its leading position among Palestinian institutions in the 2027 QS World University Rankings.

The university achieved 13th place in the Middle East and Africa rankings, repeating its position from the previous year. Al-Quds University continues to lead Palestinian higher education institutions in business administration education by this measure.
